raw_translation: For periodic compounding, APY = (ZXQPH0000QXZ + APR ÷ m)^m − ZXQPH0001QXZ, where m is the number of compounding periods per year. To convert APY back to nominal APR, use APR = m × ((ZXQPH0002QXZ + APY)^(ZXQPH0003QXZ/m) − ZXQPH0004QXZ). Continuous compounding uses APY = e^APR − ZXQPH0005QXZ. Enter rates as percentages; for example, ZXQPH0006QXZ means ZXQPH0007QXZ.
source: For periodic compounding, APY = (1 + APR ÷ m)^m − 1, where m is the number of compounding periods per year. To convert APY back to nominal APR, use APR = m × ((1 + APY)^(1/m) − 1). Continuous compounding uses APY = e^APR − 1. Enter rates as percentages; for example, 12 means 12%.
translation: For periodic compounding, APY = (1 + APR ÷ m)^m − 1, where m is the number of compounding periods per year. To convert APY back to nominal APR, use APR = m × ((1 + APY)^(1/m) − 1). Continuous compounding uses APY = e^APR − 1. Enter rates as percentages; for example, 12 means 12%.

raw_translation: Za'a iya bincika amsoshin da ake iya karantawa na CORS kawai. Wani lokaci ko amsa da ba'a iya karantawa ba shi ne abin da ba'a sani ba, ba shi da shaidar cewa alaƙa ta ɓace; ZXQPH0000QXZ, ZXQPH0001QXZ da ZXQPH0002QXZ yanayin za'a iya duba su kuma. Yi amfani da URLs na jama'a kawai da kake yarda da su.
source: Each destination can see your network address. Only CORS-readable responses can be inspected. A timeout or unreadable response is unknown, not proof the link is broken; 401, 403 and 405 statuses also need review. Use only public URLs you trust.
translation: Za'a iya bincika amsoshin da ake iya karantawa na CORS kawai. Wani lokaci ko amsa da ba'a iya karantawa ba shi ne abin da ba'a sani ba, ba shi da shaidar cewa alaƙa ta ɓace; 401, 403 da 405 yanayin za'a iya duba su kuma. Yi amfani da URLs na jama'a kawai da kake yarda da su.
